Vendor GHSA https://github.com/MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp/security/advisories/GHSA-v72x-2h86-7f8m (withdrawn_at null) names MessagePackSerializer.TryDecompress as the sink: wire Int32 lengths feed destination allocation for Lz4Block and per-block/aggregate allocation for Lz4BlockArray (CWE-409/CWE-770).

At 06ea24954efa0fe6f1cac5d87046f9b54dac2dcc (parent of the v3 fix) src/MessagePack/MessagePackSerializer.cs TryDecompress does int uncompressedLength = extReader.ReadInt32() then writer.GetSpan(uncompressedLength) with no cap; the Lz4BlockArray loop repeats ReadInt32 plus GetSpan per block with no remaining-max decrement. The same unbounded GetSpan path is present on v3.1.6 and v2.5.205.

Immediate parent 23674873e020d8ce96e4bd2b87b3ed2856ce06fa already reads the wire Int32 into length and contains new byte[length], but the guard is if (!(buffer.Length < length)), so a declared length larger than the 64KiB pool buffer never reaches the allocation.

bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73 is the first public commit that completes the source-to-sink: git diff against that parent on src/MessagePack.LZ4/LZ4MessagePackSerializer.cs flips the guard to if (buffer.Length < length), so an oversized attacker-declared length allocates new byte[length]. MessagePack.LZ4.csproj in that commit defines ENABLE_UNSAFE_RESOLVER for Debug and Release, so the #if-wrapped file is compiled.

Later 91efb454b1b5b36cd84d5ac9444617492803a7be / f493a06a104445ab06856c9a4bee86e7464aefda rewrite the same path to TryDecompress plus writer.GetSpan(uncompressedLength), and 2865743ce5e1dac5951dee7dbc1417fdcd40d8c9 / 704d430cbdd6a3477896fd4b25cf296baf84aeec extend it to Lz4BlockArray; those are refactors/extensions, not first-writes of the unbounded declared-length allocation.

findings: GHSA-v72x-2h86-7f8m / CVE-2026-48510 is a real published allocation-amplification bug: attacker-controlled LZ4 declared output lengths are used to size destination buffers before any expansion cap or decoder validation.

The smallest surviving public BIC is bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73, which flipped if (!(buffer.Length < length)) to if (buffer.Length < length) so a huge wire Int32 reaches new byte[length]. Parent 23674873e020d8ce96e4bd2b87b3ed2856ce06fa does not have that complete path.
The BIC is a single-parent 2017-03-09 commit by named human neuecc <ils@neue.cc> with no AI/bot/generator markers, so the case is NOT_AI.

Direct fixes 2b5a500ac56c2ae59183337e93cbe7dd1a5a6164 (v3.1.7) and 853429a0f438fcdc8a7ee3c158ee838f12a5be48 (v2.5.301) close both maintained lines by rejecting negative/excessive declared lengths before GetSpan.
Lz4BlockArray (2865743ce5e1dac5951dee7dbc1417fdcd40d8c9 then 704d430cbdd6a3477896fd4b25cf296baf84aeec) reuses the same missing bound and is not a separate origin.
